sections.title: In the bank, in the museum
sections.content: To say where someone is, add *-ban* or *-ben* to the place, and use *a* or *az*: *Anna a bankban van.* Back vowels take *-ban*, front vowels take *-ben*: *a múzeumban*, *az étteremben*. A final *-a* or *-e* lengthens: *szálloda → szállodában*, *iskola → iskolában*. Ask *Hol vagy?* (Where are you?) and answer *A kórházban vagyok.*

items.english: Where are you? – I am in the hotel.
I have lunch in the restaurant.

sections.content: Keep the accent on the lengthened vowel: *szállodában* is right, *szállodaban* is a misspelling.
